description: List scheduled monuments around a point in England, nearest first, with date scheduled, area and the official link. Answers 'are there any scheduled monuments on or near this land' for development checks and metal-detecting permission. Source: Historic England National Heritage List for England. Takes lat/lon; includes any monument whose mapped area overlaps the search square, with distance to its reference point rather than its edge. (cost: 1 credit)

lat.description: number, required, latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84)

lon.description: number, required, longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84)

radius_m.description: integer, optional, search radius in metres 10-5000, default 1000

name: scheduled_monuments_near
